messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(7 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. This is really four independent changes (wiring `fp` through yaml_lnet_peer_display(), the yaml_quotation_handling() rewrite, the unrecognized-tunable-key skip in handle_cmn_tunable(), and an MGS proc typo); each fixes a different bug in a different subsystem and would be easier to review and land as its own patch with its own ticket. The yaml_quotation_handling() rewrite also changes behaviour that sanity-lnet does not currently cover - a test that runs an lnetctl command whose YAML value needs quoting (for example `lnetctl cpt-of-nid 10.0.0.[1-4]@tcp`) would pin the old segfault and the new stripping rules at the same time.
Abandoned
